info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Case Management API
info.description: The Card Case Management API enables users to efficiently update and resolve card case issues within the banking service framework. This endpoint allows consumers, such as customer service representatives and automated systems, to submit changes to existing card cases based on identified parameters. The primary resource is the card case, which represents individual issues related to card servicing. Typical use cases include updating status, note additions, or case resolution efforts, ensuring that banking operations run smoothly.
